title: Litigation trends around GST input tax credit disputes
p1:
Your GST credit can be genuine and still become a legal battle.

Many businesses are surprised to learn that claiming Input Tax Credit (ITC) is not only about having invoices in hand.
p2: A common misconception is that a valid purchase invoice automatically guarantees ITC approval. Recent disputes show that authorities often examine whether suppliers actually reported transactions, whether tax was paid, and whether records match across systems.
p3:
The key trend in GST litigation is moving from simple invoice checks to deeper verification of transaction authenticity. Businesses are now focusing more on supplier compliance, reconciliation, and maintaining clear documentation.

A small mismatch today can become a major dispute tomorrow. Strong internal checks and regular GST reviews can reduce unnecessary litigation risks.
